test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 31 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Name the largest milk producing country in the world.
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India is the world's largest milk producer,** accounting for 22% of the glob**al milk production. **
 
• **The United States, Pakistan, China, and Brazil follow India in milk production. **
 
• India's milk production has increased by more than 61% from 2013-14 to 2021-22.
 
• The** world's milk production has increased by more than 77% in the last three decades**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Uttar Pradesh is the top milk-producing state in India, contributing 17% of the nation's total production.
 
• Uttar Pradesh has the highest buffalo population in the country and the second highest cattle population.
 
• The majority of rural population in the state is engaged in livestock and dairying.
 
• Number two and third place are held by Rajasthan (11.5%) and Andhra Pradesh (9%) respectively, in milk production.
